text: Himo Anndi Senayee wonanii Mo ko Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen woni kon e mu'un immorde e Malaaka en ɓen e yimɓe ɓen ado tageede maɓɓe e ɓaawo maayde maɓɓe, ko ka Alla Kanko tun fiyakuuji ɗin ruttetee Ñalnde Darngal, nokku ka O immintinoyta jeyaaɓe makko ɓen O yoɓa ɓe e dow ko ɓe ardini kon immorde e golle.
